## Summary

The `api-routes` skill is **pure documentation** — a guidelines/reference file (`SKILL.md` only) teaching how to write API routes in Expo Router with EAS Hosting. It contains **no setup scripts, no skill-owned executables, and no install steps**. - Read and analyzed `SKILL.md`.
